title: 第十五章 棺材板和姑爷第十六章 人人都道好姻缘
lines: 只要躲在厨房，不用顾及保持仪态，对于张寿来说，吃几个饺子不过一会儿功夫的事。
从前他只是疑惑，可如今他走在村里，心中却隐隐有了一个判断。
张家所在的这个村子总共三四十户人家，百多口人，说大不大，说小却也不算很小。村子里几乎全都是佃户，姓氏不一，没有独立耕种的富农，更没有其他地主。
对于远离城市，没有王法只有宗法族法的乡下，这种诸姓杂居，只有他们孤儿寡母算是富足的情况，这绝对不正常。
而且，这三年来，他也没见到过那种痞子恶霸之类的角色。就算齐良遭遇过债主追债，可那也是正常的民间借贷，主要是不事生产却又债台高筑的齐父自找的。
现在想想，这村子的佃户应该是经过谨慎选择的。如果是这样，那位赵国公也不算对他们母子不闻不问，至少人家不但养了孤儿寡母，还给他们建立起了一个良好的生存环境。
不过，眼下这个远离喧嚣的宁静村庄，正变得如同菜市场。
这大中午时分本来便是每日收割时唯一的休息机会，村中不再只有小孩子，大人们都从地里回来了。尤其是如今收割季几乎就要结束的时候，人们的嗓门似乎都高了。
于是，当八个来自赵国公府的护卫，为了大小姐和自己的安居而进行采办时，在家的村民们面对那些从衣着就能看出很阔绰的护卫们，一问清楚买什么，他们就兴奋不已。
大通铺需要板子，打造新床同样需要板子，而在这么个小村庄，最好的板子打哪来？
此时，张寿便亲眼看到，村中年纪最大，自称德高望重的杨老倌，让两个儿子把自己攒了一辈子的一副棺材板抬到了家门口，自己亲自把衣着光鲜的朱宏硬是请了过来，随即就指着自己那副还没解开的板子开始了天花乱坠的吹嘘。
老头儿间或还拿手指在上头叩击，以此证明木料确实上好。
至于朱宏……听说这是早早攒下的棺材板，整张脸都有些青了。
张寿原本只不过是驻足看热闹，可当发现朱宏瞧见了自己时，他心中一动，干脆主动上了前。
果然，看到他来，朱宏明显露出了如释重负的表情。
“寿公子，”他先行了礼，随即就干咳一声道，“我们不过是临时住几天，怎好挪用别人家的寿材……”
斜睨那个眼珠子乱转的杨老倌，张寿就知道，这个村里人嘴中早就一只脚伸进棺材板的老头儿是什么真实想法。他立刻打断朱宏，语重心长地说：“我知道，寿材二字，听上去不吉利。可既不吉利，为什么人都提早准备板子，甚至有人生前就把板子解锯糊漆直接做好？”
“很简单，为了冲一冲，把疾病和祸害冲走。既然能冲走，那么证明这听着不吉利的东西，其实是很有福气的。而且，这村里的人热情淳朴，听说诸位远来是客，在这儿暂居却缺少床铺，这才肯让出他们积攒一辈子的东西，你要是不愿意，他们只会认为你瞧不起他们。”
朱宏只觉得这话听着有哪里不大对劲，可张寿实在是说得太诚恳了，所以他不知不觉有些犹疑。尤其是见一旁那父子三人明显有些气鼓鼓的，分明被张寿说中了心思，他就更加为难了起来。然而，真正压弯骆驼的最后一根稻草，却还在后头。
“要打一张像样的床，在没有好板子的情况下是不可能的，我想府里总不可能专程从京城送板子来？现砍树倒是可以，但不说别的，不晾干怎么开工？如果你忌讳这是寿材板子，那就这样，我那张床回头让给你们睡，这板子新做的床给我，如何？”
“那怎么行！”
在张家后墙树上熬了一宿，眼睛里此时还有血丝的朱宏顿时头皮发麻。虽说大小姐和张寿还没成婚，但太夫人都把人当成了未来姑爷看待，他就算打心眼觉得从小长在乡下的张寿除了一张脸，哪都配不上大小姐，却不可能为了自己那点忌讳，就让张寿去睡棺材板做的床！
万一回头人折寿……呸呸呸，先别胡思乱想……
他深深吸了一口气，最终硬着头皮说：“既然如此，板子我买了就是！”
他瞅了一眼那明显是上了年头，而且有人擦拭摩挲，所以依旧显得挺圆润，尚未真正做成棺材的板子，告诫自己不要忌讳这种神神鬼鬼的东西，一锤定音道：“二十两银子，我拿走就是！”
杨家父子顿时眉飞色舞，等看到张寿转过身来，满脸恳切地和他们商量价钱，三人立时小鸡啄米似的连连点头，满口答应。
眼见朱宏也不叫人帮忙，撂下银子直接把板子扛走，杨老倌捧着沉甸甸的那锭雪花大银，等人已经走远之后，他方才上前一步，小声对张寿问道：“小先生，你家里这些客人哪来的，我还想开价五贯钱呢，他居然直接一口就是二十两！到底是有钱人，都不用制钱，只用银子。”
“呵呵，京城来的。”张寿说着便一笑，见杨老倌登时倒吸一口凉气，他就又慢吞吞地补充了一句，“赵国公府朱家的。”
他故意揭破朱宏来历，随即果然注意到，杨老倌脸色倏然一变，反倒是杨家两个儿子只是纯粹的惊愕，仿佛是觉得那么高高在上的贵人突然和自家小村子搭上关系，实在很稀奇。
“二十两买去你的板子，到徐木匠那边锯开，打磨上漆做床，这燃眉之急就算解决了，否则从别处买，车马费人工费都是钱，所以他这钱花得不亏。而且，他们又不会在我家常住，回头人一走，这些床板我留着也没用，自然还是还给你。一来一回，全都便宜了你！”
张寿故意把话说得极其轻松，杨家二子自觉占了大便宜，一时喜形于色，大的那个更是打躬作揖道：“多亏小先生，否则我们也赚不到这银子。回头我再去给老爹订一副杉木好板子，顶了天花个几两银子，剩下的足够咱们家两个小子娶媳妇了！”
“哼，就那两个没用的小东西，小先生肯教他们认字读书，居然不好好学，活该娶不上媳妇！都是你们两个，上梁不正下梁歪，还不赶紧滚进去！”
杨老倌突然大骂了两句，随即蛮不讲理撵走了两个儿子，这才脸色复杂地将刚刚揣在怀里的二十两银子递还到张寿面前。
见此情景，心里已经有所猜测的张寿便很自然地露出了诧异之色：“你这是干什么？”
“早知道是赵国公府的人，我怎么也不会收这二十两银子，小先生代我还回去吧！”
张寿自然不肯接：“你是怕赵国公府的人觉得你坑了他们的钱？是他自己给的，又不是你漫天要价。再说，你不是成天嚷嚷腰腿疼？拿着钱去好好瞧瞧大夫，开药调理调理，还能多活几年。人家赵国公府在京城买一张床说不定都得百八十两，不在乎这点钱！”
“话不是这么说……”一贯以中气足嗓门大在村里著称的杨老倌这会儿声音低沉，老半晌方才叹了一口气，抬起头道，“我毕竟曾经是赵国公手下的兵，这条命要不是赵国公巡营的时候叫了军医给救下的，早就丢在塞外了。再说，拿棺材板给活人做床这种事……”
他说到这儿，突然顿了一顿，疑惑不解地看向张寿道：“对了，赵国公府的人怎会到这乡间来，还要打床，听着是要常住？难不成他们住在小先生你家？”
张寿本来还在庆幸终于找到了一个疑似知情者，能打探点这村子的来龙去脉，此时听到杨老倌这话，他就仿佛兴头上被浇了盆凉水。
可他知道这老家伙有多刁滑，很快便下了一剂猛药。
“别提了，我闭门家中坐，未婚妻天上掉下来，还是赵国公府大小姐！”
然而，他万万没想到，话音刚落，杨老倌两眼放光，竟喜笑颜开地叫道：“原来是姑爷！”
content_en:
As long as he hides in the kitchen and doesn't have to worry about maintaining his appearance, it only takes a while for Zhang Shou to eat a few dumplings.
In the past, he was just confused, but now as he walked in the village, he had a vague judgment in his heart.
The village where the Zhang family is located has a total of thirty or forty households, with a population of more than a hundred. It may not be big, but it is not small either. The village is almost entirely made up of tenant farmers with different surnames. There are no rich farmers who farm independently, and there are no other landowners.
For the countryside far away from the city, where there is no royal law but only clan law, this kind of situation where all the surnames live together, and only their orphans and widowed mothers are considered wealthy, this is absolutely abnormal.
Moreover, in the past three years, he has never seen a ruffian or bully. Even if Qi Liang encountered debt collection by creditors, it was a normal private loan. It was mainly brought by Qi's father who was not engaged in production but was heavily in debt.
Now that I think about it, the tenants in this village should have been carefully selected. If this is the case, the Duke of Zhao is not indifferent to their mother and son. At least he not only raised orphans and widows, but also established a good living environment for them.
However, this quiet village away from the hustle and bustle is now becoming like a vegetable market.
This noon time was originally the only chance to rest during the daily harvest. Children were no longer the only ones in the village, adults had all returned from the fields. Especially now that the harvest season is almost over, people's voices seem to be rising.
So, when the eight guards from Zhao Guogong's mansion made purchases for the eldest lady and themselves, the villagers at home were very excited when they faced those guards who could tell from their clothing that they were very luxurious.
Datong shop requires boards, and building a new bed also requires boards. But in such a small village, where can the best boards be obtained?
At this time, Zhang Shou saw with his own eyes that Yang Laoguan, the oldest man in the village and who claimed to be highly respected, asked his two sons to carry a pair of coffin boards that he had saved all his life to the door of his house. He personally invited the well-dressed Zhu Hong over, and then pointed at the board that he had not yet untied and started to brag.
The old man would occasionally tap on it with his fingers to prove that the wood was indeed of good quality.
As for Zhu Hong... I heard that this was a coffin board that he had saved early, and his whole face was a little blue.
Zhang Shou originally just stopped to watch the excitement, but when he realized that Zhu Hong had seen him, he felt moved and took the initiative to step forward.
Sure enough, Zhu Hong showed an expression of relief when he saw him coming.
"Master Longevity," he saluted first, then coughed dryly and said, "We are just staying here temporarily for a few days, how can we appropriate other people's longevity materials..."
Looking sideways at the old man Yang, whose eyes were wandering around, Zhang Shou knew what the villagers really thought about the old man who had already had one foot stuck in the coffin board. He immediately interrupted Zhu Hong and said earnestly: "I know, the word longevity material sounds unlucky. But if it is unlucky, why do people prepare boards in advance, and some people even unsaw and paste the boards directly before they die?"
"It's very simple, just to wash away diseases and disasters. Since it can be washed away, it proves that this thing that sounds unlucky is actually very blessed. Moreover, the people in this village are warm and simple. I heard that you are guests from afar and are living here temporarily but lack beds, so they are willing to give up what they have accumulated throughout their lives. If you are not willing, they will only think that you look down on them."
Zhu Hong only felt that there was something wrong with what he said, but Zhang Shou really said it too sincerely, so he hesitated unconsciously. Especially when he saw that the father and son on the side were obviously a little angry, and it was clear that Zhang Shou had got what he said, he became even more embarrassed. However, the straw that truly broke the camel's back was yet to come.
"It is impossible to make a decent bed without good boards. I think it is impossible for the government to specially send boards from the capital. It is okay to cut down trees now, but if you don't talk about anything else, how can you start the work without drying it? If you are afraid that this is a long-lasting board, then let it be like this. I will let you sleep on my bed later, and give me a new bed made from this board. How about it?"
"How can that be done!"
After spending the night in the tree on the back wall of Zhang's house, Zhu Hong, whose eyes were still bloodshot at this moment, suddenly felt his scalp numb. Although the eldest lady and Zhang Shou were not married yet, the wife regarded them as their future uncles. Even if he felt that Zhang Shou, who grew up in the countryside, was not worthy of the eldest lady except for his face, it was impossible for him to let Zhang Shou sleep on a bed made of coffin boards just because of his own taboo!
What if my life is shortened... Bah, bah, bah, don't think about it yet...
He took a deep breath and finally said bravely: "In that case, I will just buy the board!"
He took a look at the board, which was obviously old and had been wiped and rubbed by someone, so it still looked quite round. It had not yet been made into a coffin. He warned himself not to be taboo about such mysterious things, and said firmly: "I'll take the twenty taels of silver!"
The Yang family's father and son were immediately elated. When they saw Zhang Shou turning around and discussing the price with them sincerely, the three of them immediately nodded like chickens pecking at rice and agreed.
Seeing that Zhu Hong didn't ask anyone for help, he put down the silver and carried the board away. Yang Laoguo held the heavy ingot of snowflake silver in his hands. After the others had gone away, he took a step forward and asked Zhang Shou in a low voice: "Little sir, where do these guests in your house come from? I wanted to offer five taels, but he actually gave me 20 taels in one bite! After all, rich people don't need to make money, they only use silver."
"Haha, I'm from the capital." Zhang Shou smiled as he said this. Seeing Yang Laoguan immediately take a breath of cold air, he added slowly, "He is from the Zhu family of Duke Zhao's mansion."
He deliberately exposed Zhu Hong's origins, and then he noticed that Yang Laoguan's expression suddenly changed, while the two Yang sons were simply shocked, as if they thought it was strange that such a high-ranking nobleman suddenly had a relationship with their small village.
"Buy your boards for twenty taels, go to Carpenter Xu to saw them, polish them and paint them to make a bed. This urgent need is solved. Otherwise, if you buy them from elsewhere, the transportation and labor costs are all money, so he spent the money well. Moreover, they will not live in my house permanently. Once they leave, there will be no use for me to keep these bed boards, so naturally I will return them to you. Every time I come here, I will give you an advantage!"
Zhang Shou deliberately said it in an extremely relaxed way. The second son of the Yang family felt that they had taken advantage of it, and they were overjoyed for a moment. The older one bowed and said, "Thanks to Mr. Young, otherwise we wouldn't be able to earn this money. Later I will order a pair of good fir wood boards for my father, and I will pay for the ceiling for a few taels of silver. The rest will be enough for our two boys to get wives!"
"Huh, just those two useless little things. The little gentleman is willing to teach them how to read and read, but they don't study hard. They deserve not to get a wife! It's the two of you who have a crooked upper beam and a crooked lower beam. Why don't you get out of there!"
Yang Laoguan suddenly cursed a few words, and then drove away his two sons unreasonably. Then with a complex expression, he handed the twenty taels of silver he had just carried back to Zhang Shou.
Seeing this scene, Zhang Shou, who had already made some assumptions in his mind, was naturally surprised: "What are you doing?"
"If I had known that it was from Duke Zhao's mansion, I would never have accepted these twenty taels of silver. Young gentleman, please pay it back on my behalf!"
Zhang Shou naturally refused to accept: "Are you afraid that the people in Duke Zhao's Palace think you cheated them of their money? He gave it to him himself, and you didn't ask for an exorbitant price. Besides, aren't you complaining about your waist and leg pain all day long? Take the money and go see the doctor, prescribe medicine and treat it, and you can live for a few more years. The Duke of Zhao's Palace may buy a bed in the capital for a hundred and eighty taels, so you don't care about this little money!"
"That's not what you say..." Yang Laoguan, who was always known in the village for his powerful and loud voice, now had a low voice. After a long while, he sighed and raised his head and said, "After all, I was once a soldier under Zhao Guogong. If Zhao Guogong hadn't called a military doctor to save my life when he was patrolling the camp, I would have been abandoned outside the Great Wall. Besides, using coffin boards to make a bed for a living person..."
When he said this, he suddenly paused and looked at Zhang Shou in confusion: "By the way, how come the people from Zhao Guogong's mansion come to this country and make beds? It sounds like they want to stay permanently? Is it possible that they live in your house, Mr. Xiao?"
Zhang Shou was originally glad that he finally found a suspected insider who could find out the ins and outs of this village. But when he heard Yang Laoguan's words, he seemed to have been poured cold water on his excitement.
But he knew how cunning this old guy was, so he quickly took a strong dose.
"Forget it, I was sitting at home behind closed doors, and my fiancée fell from the sky, and she was still the eldest daughter of the Duke of Zhao!"
However, he never expected that as soon as he finished speaking, Yang Laoguan's eyes lit up and he shouted with a smile: "It turns out to be my uncle!"
title_en: Chapter 15: The Coffin Board and My Uncle Chapter 16: Everyone Says Good Marriage
